note: exposed_comm_s = step_time_p50 - matched baseline p50, both replicate means; exposed_comm_unc_s is the propagated standard error, and is null unless both sides were replicated -- a single sample has unknown spread, not zero spread. For an n=1 cell, take the cv of the same strategy from a replicated cell as the proxy (fsdp-full ~1%, ddp ~1%, DeepSpeed stage 3 ~3.5%). exposed_comm_normalised divides by (N-1)/N so GPU counts compare. Replicates pool across tags -- see samples[] to re-pool. wall_clock_breakdown phase timings are not here: DeepSpeed prints them to rank 0 stdout and no results JSON captures them.
